checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and the last IDT review date; list all events since the prior review, including ED visits and hospital admissions, with reasons.

New atrial fibrillation (ECG finding, apixaban started 2026-10-29): verify the date of diagnosis, the ECG source, rate/rhythm documentation, and whether the team has discussed the new anticoagulant alongside clopidogrel (dual antithrombotic exposure) and the patient's fall history and bleeding signs. Flag for clinician review; do not recommend changes.
Falls and injuries: count falls, near-falls, and any head strike or injury since the window start; note orthostatic symptoms, dizziness, or syncope, given antihypertensive changes.

Blood pressure trend: review all BP readings in the window against the 2026-05-04 start of amlodipine, hydrochlorothiazide, and lisinopril, plus existing metoprolol; flag low readings, orthostatic drops, or readings outside the team's documented targets.

Renal and electrolyte monitoring: check most recent creatinine/eGFR, potassium, and sodium given diabetic kidney disease, proteinuria, lisinopril and hydrochlorothiazide use; confirm labs are current and any results are flagged for the team.

Tacrolimus (Envarsus, started 2026-05-04): confirm the indication is documented, check trough levels and dates, and review any renal or glucose changes; flag for prescriber review rather than assessing dosing.

Medication starts and stops since last review: reconcile the list, noting simvastatin 10 mg started 2026-06-18 while simvastatin 20 mg remains active (possible duplication), and confirm which statin dose is intended; check for any stopped medications not documented.

Cognition and dementia: review Alzheimer's progression measures (MoCA/MMSE or equivalent), donepezil/memantine adherence, behavioral symptoms, and any new delirium signs, especially after new medications.
Sleep and OSA: check CPAP or sleep therapy use and adherence, daytime sleepiness, and any sleep-related complaints; note sedating or sleep-affecting medication changes.
Function, ADLs and nutrition: review ADL/IADL scores, mobility aids, weight trend (obesity history, BMI 30+), appetite, and any change in dental or swallowing status (loss of teeth).

Mood, pain, and caregiver: screen for depression or anxiety (e.g., PHQ-2/9), review chronic pain scores and analgesic use, check anemia-related symptoms and recent hemoglobin, and confirm caregiver status, strain, and any changes in home support or living situation; list care-plan items due in the window (prostate surveillance, eye/foot diabetes exams, immunizations, advance care planning).
